newsitem.title: USA: American Communications to sell 8 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: American Communications to sell 8 mln shrs.

text.p: American Communications Services Inc said Thursday it was planned to sell eight million shares to raise net proceeds of $36.8 million.
Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp are the managing underwriters for a public offering of 4.4 million shares at $5 each, it said.
Another 3.6 million shares will be sold by the company directly to certain principal stockholders, at the same price the underwriters paid to the company, American Communications said.
It said it had granted the underwriters an option to purchase an additional 660,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
Proceeds will be used primarily to integrate the company's local and coast-to-coast communication networks, American Communications said.
